topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence:
In some cases, fees are negotiable. Talk to your investment professional about reducing them.
If you still feel there is a problem with your fees, report your concern to the SEC, FINRA, or the North American Securities Administrators Association (NASAA).
answer: If your investment fees seem too high, ask your investment professional to explain them and discuss whether they can be reduced; in some cases, fees are negotiable. If you are not satisfied with the explanation, consider following up in writing. If you still believe there is a problem, you can report your concern to the SEC, FINRA, or NASAA. The source gives examples of possible problems, including being charged more than the agreed fees or signs of excessive trading in your account.
